The '''Battle of Goibniu''' was a space battle between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that took place when Rebel starfighters attempted to disable or destroy [[Goibniu Platform]], an Imperial supply depot in the [[Goibniu system/Legends|Goibniu system]], to allow [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] to steal Imperial [[Class-E cargo container]]s containing valuable [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]].

==The Battle==
[[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] entered the Goibniu system in [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]], escorted by [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] in outdated [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]]. Luckily, Imperial opposition came principally in the form of two squadrons of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN fighters]], the basic starfighter of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Gold Squadron attempted to neutralize Goibniu Platform, an [[XQ2 Platform|XQ2 platform]], in order to allow SFNGR Group to capture and carry away Imperial bacta supplies.

The Rebels were outnumbered and outgunned, but they had an ace up their sleeve&mdash;several [[Ace/Legends|aces]], actually, in the form of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. Members of the elite group, including [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] and [[Rogue Two/Legends|Rogue Two]], may have intercepted Imperial TIE fighters in their [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] if the Gold or Blue Squadron pilots engaged at Goibniu required assistance. The Imperials may have countered a Rebel advantage with Rho Squadron, an outfit of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] on patrol either nearby or in the farther reaches of the embattled system.

==Behind the scenes==
As players can participate in the mission "Raid on Goibniu Platform" in the computer game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' on either the Rebel or the Imperial side, both sides have conflicting mission objectives, and victory is not essential to access the next set of missions, the battle itself is considered canon but the canon outcome is unknown.

The ships listed in this article are those found in the battle [[Operation: Clean Sweep]], using the default craft assigned to the player.
